author: Wixely
name: Nodestar site
description: A CupriNet node that hosts a site at a self-authenticating cupri1… address, served to browsers over WebRTC and to everything else over HTTP.

network.description: The Concordium (network) this node joins. Nodes only meet others using the same name.

moniker.description: A human-readable label for this node. Cosmetic; the cupri1… address is the identity.

tor.description: Add the onion transport, so the site can be served over Tor.
